properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 20 at 8:37PM EDT until September 20 at 9:15PM EDT by NWS Wilmington OH
properties.description:
SVRILN

The National Weather Service in Wilmington has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Fayette County in central Ohio...
Northern Clinton County in southwestern Ohio...
Southeastern Greene County in west central Ohio...
Southwestern Madison County in central Ohio...

* Until 915 PM EDT.

* At 836 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Jamestown,
moving east at 40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to trees and power lines.

* Locations impacted include...
Xenia, Washington Court House, Sabina, Jamestown, Jeffersonville,
Bloomingburg, Wilberforce, New Jasper, Staunton, Good Hope,
Bowersville, Port William, Milledgeville, Octa, Paintersville,
Melvin, Interstate 71 at State Route 38, Rosemoor, Lumberton, and
Madison Mills.

This includes I-71 in Ohio between mile markers 46 and 78.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

To report severe weather, go to our website at weather.gov/iln and
submit your report via social media, when you can do so safely.
